title: Corporate brand lab (source of the Corporate Brand pack)
summary: The comps every Corporate Brand template was built and verified in: split-rule title card, two-box lower third, frame logo resolve and three stats.
use_when: You want to see a corporate pattern working before using it, copy its objects into a brand film, or re-extract a template after changing it.

comps: CB Lower third (150 f, masked, growing windows)

carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-27
copy_notes: Each comp has a 'Lab bg' rectangle; templates are extracted with --drop "Lab bg" (Three stats keeps its light background).
Masks: each window is the mask; mask.make takes the FIRST id as the mask.
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/corporate_brand_lab.py, then PRESETS and MASKS, edit.save.
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-27
